feedback.problem:
| $f$ | $Y=1$ | $Y=3$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $X=0$ | $0.2$ | $0.05$ |
| $X=3$ | $0.3$ | $0.1$ |
| $X=6$ | $0.05$ | $0.2$ |
| $X=9$ | $0.1$ | $0$ |

Compute $P(3\le X\le 9\,|\,Y=3)$ given that the discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above. Round your answer to two decimal places.
feedback.worked_solution:
By the multiplication law for conditional probability, the required conditional probability is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}P(3\le X\le 9\,|\,Y=3) & =\frac{P((3\le X\le 9),Y=3)}{P(Y=3)} \\  & =\frac{P(X=3,Y=3)+P(X=6,Y=3)+P(X=9,Y=3)}{P(Y=3)} \\  & =\frac{f(3,3)+f(6,3)+f(9,3)}{{f}_{Y}(3)},\end{aligned}
$$

where $f(x,y)$ is the joint probability mass function of $X$ and $Y,$ and ${f}_{Y}(y)$ is the marginal distribution of $Y.$

Recall that the marginal distribution for $Y$ corresponds to the column totals. Thus,

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{Y}(3) & =f(0,3)+f(3,3)+f(6,3)+f(9,3) \\  & =0.05+0.1+0.2+0 \\  & =0.35.\end{aligned}
$$

From the given table, we have that $f(3,3)=0.1,f(6,3)=0.2$ and $f(9,3)=0.$ 

Finally, substituting our values into our formula above, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}P(3\le X\le 9\,|\,Y=3) & =\frac{f(3,3)+f(6,3)+f(9,3)}{{f}_{Y}(3)} \\  & =\frac{0.1+0.2+0}{0.35} \\  & =\frac{0.3}{0.35} \\  & ≈0.86.\end{aligned}
$$
